newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Meralco up on stocks sale rumour.
newsitem.headline: Meralco up on stocks sale rumour.

text.p: Both A and B shares of Manila Electric Co rose by midsession on a rumour that the government will soon sell the sequestered shares to the public, brokers said.
The A shares gained 5.00 pesos, or 5.0 percent, to 105 pesos, while the B shares rose by 11.00 pesos, or 6.32 percent, to 185 pesos. The B shares are open to foreign investors.
"There is a rumour going around the government is going to sell the sequestered shares ... It will give additional liquidity to the shares," an analyst at a foreign brokerage house said.
A Meralco official said he was yet to receive any communication from the government regarding the possible sale.
Officials of the Philippine Commission on Good Government, the custodian of the sequestered shares, declined to comment on the rumours.
The shares were sequestered in 1986 on suspicion that they were bought by the late strongman Ferdinand Marcos through illegal means. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
